exposure: presence of previous caesarean section scar
absence of previous caesarean section scar
cohort: The study included 155 women undergoing termination of pregnancy between 13 and 24 weeks gestation, divided into cohorts based on the presence or absence of a previous caesarean section scar.
finding: The presence or absence of a caesarean scar did not significantly affect the induction to abortion interval, completeness of midtrimester abortions, or complication rates in women undergoing misoprostol-induced abortion.
mod_finding: The presence of a previous caesarean scar, representing a prior mode of birth, did not affect the induction to abortion interval, completeness of abortions, or complication rates in misoprostol-induced midtrimester abortions.
gest_age: Between 13 and 24 weeks (mean 14.6 weeks for previous C-sections, 15.2 weeks for previous vaginal deliveries)
